rationale: The workflow already implements the applicable evidence-supported optimizations. It uses actions/cache extensively for the Haskell Stack dependency pipeline (Pantry index, configured GHC, dependencies from stack*.lock, and .stack-work modules), matching P-LIT-GHA-CACHE. It already cancels superseded runs via concurrency with cancel-in-progress: true, matching P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE. Both jobs already carry explicit timeouts (2 min and 45 min), matching P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT. The remaining candidate, P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (changing fail-fast from false to true), is not supported: the matrix explicitly sets fail-fast: false, indicating all build configurations are intended to run, and the pattern's contraindications (every matrix outcome required; full failure diagnostics required) cannot be resolved because required_checks is not_verified. No additional cache, timeout, or cancellation change is warranted without weakening coverage or making unrelated modifications.
